    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"

        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"

        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) and 2 of ($http*)
}
